description: This PHP class 'TreeInterpreter' is part of a library for evaluating JMESPath expressions by traversing their Abstract Syntax Tree (AST). It interprets nodes of different types and performs corresponding evaluation logic.

classes.name: TreeInterpreter
classes.description: A class that evaluates JMESPath AST expressions by traversing the AST and executing different logic based on node type.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Initializes the interpreter with an optional function dispatcher callback.

methods.name: visit
methods.description: Starts the AST traversal and evaluation with a given node and data.

methods.name: dispatch
methods.description: Recursively traverses the AST node, evaluates each node based on its type, and implements the core logic of the interpreter.
